findings.title: Reused key with different amount/currency returns the stale receipt instead of a conflict
findings.evidence: begin() short-circuits on key membership only and returns the stored receipt: 'return self._completed[key]'; charge_once then returns it at line 52 without comparing amount_cents/currency to the stored request.
findings.recommendation: Store the original request parameters alongside the receipt (e.g. _completed[key] = (amount_cents, currency, receipt)) and raise a conflict error (HTTP 409/422 style) when a repeat call presents the same key with different amount_cents or currency, instead of returning the prior receipt silently.

findings.title: None is used as the not-completed sentinel, so a None receipt re-charges
findings.evidence: begin() returns the stored value for a completed key, but charge_once treats None as unclaimed: 'if prior is not None:'. If gateway.charge ever returns None (or a None-like receipt), the key stays in _completed with value None and every subsequent call falls through to gateway.charge again, i.e. a double charge of the same key.
findings.recommendation: Use an explicit sentinel (e.g. return a (found, receipt) tuple or a module-level _MISSING object from begin) so that a falsy/None receipt is still recognised as completed.

findings.title: Completed-key map grows without bound and is per-process only
findings.evidence: Keys are only ever inserted into '_completed' (line 28) and never evicted or expired, so a long-running process leaks memory one entry per distinct key; the store is also process-local, so multi-worker deployments get no cross-process dedup.
findings.recommendation: Bound the structure: add TTL/expiry or an LRU cap on completed keys, and document (or replace with a shared/persistent store) the fact that dedup does not hold across processes.

findings.title: New money-handling entry point shipped with no tests executed
findings.evidence: charge_once is the new public entry point and the change context reports no test commands were run; the concurrency paths (begin in-flight raise, abandon-then-retry, completed-key replay) are untested.
findings.evidence_quote: def charge_once(store, gateway, amount_cents, currency, idempotency_key):
findings.recommendation: Add tests with a fake gateway covering: replay returns the identical receipt without a second gateway call, concurrent duplicate raises DuplicateRequestInFlight, gateway exception abandons the key so a retry re-charges, and rejects bool/non-positive amounts.
